name: WhaleHarness
tagline: DeepSeek Harness 的插件站：深海里的插件鲸群

plugins.name: whale-praise
plugins.description: 鲸鱼表扬局。装好后模型多一个 whale_praise 工具：任何值得表扬的事迹都能换来一条鲸群认证的鼓励。
plugins.description_en: Praise bureau: the model gains a whale_praise tool — cetacean-grade encouragement for any deed worth praising.

plugins.name: whale-fortune
plugins.description: 鲸鱼箴言。随时抽取一条深海箴言：海面之上是浪，海面之下是路。
plugins.description_en: Deep-sea aphorisms on demand: a whale_fortune tool for a moment of reflection.

plugins.name: whale-submit
plugins.description: DSH 内投稿助手：装好后，在会话里一句话就把自己的插件打包投进 WhaleHarness 公开投稿箱。审核透明，72 小时出结果。
plugins.description_en: Submit your own plugin from inside a DSH session: it packages your directory and PUTs it to the public submission box. Review is transparent.

plugins.name: whale-status
plugins.description: 站点体检：HTTPS、DNS、TLS 证书剩余天数、全部插件 tarball 的 sha256 完整性。会话里一句话给 WhaleHarness 做体检。
plugins.description_en: Site checkup: HTTPS, DNS, TLS expiry, and sha256 integrity of every published tarball — all with Node built-ins.

plugins.name: whale-brand-check
plugins.description: 品牌体检：按 whale-brand 语调给文案打分——禁用词、感叹号密度、海洋比喻数量、链接缺失、铺垫过长。审稿专用。
plugins.description_en: Brand checkup: scores copy against the whale-brand voice rules — banned words, exclamation density, metaphors, missing links.

plugins.name: whale-digest
plugins.description: 离线抽取式摘要：中英文文本提取要点句与关键词，纯本地、零依赖。作者 kwawa（外部投稿，审核通过）。
plugins.description_en: Offline extractive summarizer: main-point sentences and keywords for Chinese or English text. Fully local, zero deps. By kwawa — the first community submission to pass review.

plugins.name: whale-breathe
plugins.description: 鲸鱼呼吸法：1-10 分钟的鲸式呼吸引导（4-4-6-2 节奏），帮船员在任务间隙放松。作者 kwawa（外部投稿，修订版审核通过）。
plugins.description_en: Whale-paced breathing exercise (4-4-6-2 rhythm, 1-10 min) to reset focus between tasks. By kwawa - first rejected-then-fixed community submission.

plugins.name: whale-verify
plugins.description: 投稿前自检：与站方同一套静态审查（结构/依赖/危险模式/required:false）+ 生成四步验证环命令。自己不动手执行，零 child_process。
plugins.description_en: Pre-submission self-check: the same static review the station runs, plus the four-step verification recipe. Never executes anything itself - zero child_process.

plugins.name: whale-memory
plugins.description: 跨会话记忆：鲸替你记住。whale_memory_set/get/list/delete 四个工具，任何 DSH 会话写下的记忆，本机其它会话都能取回。官方 storage 服务持久化，无子进程无网络。
plugins.description_en: Explicit cross-session memory: the pod remembers. set/get/list/delete tools let any session on this machine recall what earlier sessions decided to keep. Official storage service, no subprocess, no network.

skills.name: whale-brand
skills.description: WhaleHarness 品牌语调：像鲸一样思考——深、稳、巧。写推广文案时用。
skills.description_en: WhaleHarness brand voice: write like a whale thinks — deep, calm, a little playful, never loud.

skills.name: whale-marketing
skills.description: WhaleHarness 推广手册：对外口径、渠道打法、度量方式。招募推广 AGENT 时必备。
skills.description_en: Promotion playbook for WhaleHarness: messaging, channels, cadence, and honest metrics.
